title: Tenant isolation for invoices
grade_detail: enforced/bypass scoring; evidence(reads) 0/2; unread=['service/invoice_service.py', 'store/invoice_repo.py']; enf='service.invoice_service.list_invoices | store.invoice_repo.list_by_tenant' by='api.invoices.handle_get_invoice | service.invoice_service.get_invoice | store.invoice_repo.get_by_id | api.invoices.hand'

title: Which README invariants fail?

evidence.I2: get_invoice fetches by invoice ID without checking the current tenant.
evidence.I3: Webhook deduplication is non-atomic: processing is marked complete only after effects, allowing duplicate deliveries to insert distinct OrderPaid outbox rows.
evidence.I4: mark_paid changes order status to paid without invalidating its cache entry.

title: Review: list_orders performance smell

findings.summary: list_orders fetches tenant-scoped rows, then redundantly calls get_order for every row, causing up to N additional repository lookups.

title: Review: cache vs status change (I4)

findings.summary: mark_paid changes the order status to paid but never calls cache.invalidate_order, leaving the cache entry present. Shared in-memory object references may mask staleness, but the required invalidation does not occur.

title: Incident: duplicate OrderPaid

answer.root_cause: Webhook deduplication is a non-atomic check-then-act: the processed marker is written only after an OrderPaid row with a fresh UUID is inserted. A failure or concurrent retry before marking processed inserts duplicates.

title: Incident: lost outbox events

answer.root_cause: process_once acknowledges each row before publishing it; a crash afterward leaves acked=true, so claim_batch never retries the unpublished event.

title: Constrained fix: webhook idempotency

plan_steps: After the duplicate check succeeds, record webhook_id in processed_webhooks before performing payment or outbox writes.
Only then insert the payment, OrderPaid outbox event, and update the order.
answer.idempotency_change: Move _mark_processed(webhook_id) from after order_service.mark_paid to immediately after the duplicate check and before outbox.insert(order_paid(...)).
